```yaml
name: lint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      R_KEEP_PKG_SOURCE: yes
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: 'release'
          install-r: true
          http-user-agent: 'release'

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: |
            any::lintr
            any::styler
            any::devtools
          needs: lint

      - name: Lint
        run: |
          # Configure lintr to use 2-space indentation
          echo 'linters_with_defaults <- list(
            trailing_whitespace = NULL,
            line_length_linter = line_length_linter(100),
            object_name_linter = object_name_linter(allow_abbreviations = TRUE),
            function_left_parentheses_linter = function_left_parentheses_linter(spaces = 1),
            spaces_inside_linter = spaces_inside_linter(spaces = 1),
            spaces_outside_linter = spaces_outside_linter(spaces = 1)
          )' > .lintr

          # Run lintr
          lintr::lint_package()

          # Style with styler
          styler::style_pkg()
          
          # Check for changes
          git diff --exit-code || {
            echo "Style changes detected. Please run styler::style_pkg() and commit the changes."
            exit 1
          }
        shell: Rscript {0}

      - name: Test
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
        shell: bash
```
